title: 语法 · 介词｜位置、路径与时间边界 · 60 句
description: 区分位置、接触、穿越、方向、起终点、时点与期限；重点是关系，不单列时态。

items.zh: 说明书粘在盒盖内侧。
items.en: The instructions are stuck to the inside of the lid.
answers: The instructions are stuck to the inside of the lid.
items.notes: to 表示附着对象；the inside of 表示内侧。

items.zh: 接待台正对着电梯门。
items.en: The reception desk is opposite the lift doors.
answers: The reception desk is opposite the lift doors.
items.notes: opposite 直接接位置对象，不必再加 to。

items.zh: 桌布下面压着一张便条。
items.en: A note is tucked beneath the tablecloth.
answers: A note is tucked beneath the tablecloth.
items.notes: beneath 表示在覆盖物下面；tuck：塞放。

items.zh: 把标签贴在瓶身上，别贴在瓶盖上。
items.en: Attach the label to the bottle, not to the cap.
answers: Attach the label to the bottle, not to the cap.
items.notes: attach A to B：把 A 附着到 B；两处 to 对照对象。

items.zh: 天花板与柜顶之间留有一道缝。
items.en: There is a gap between the ceiling and the top of the cupboard.
answers: There is a gap between the ceiling and the top of the cupboard.
items.notes: between A and B 描述两个明确边界之间。

items.zh: 壁画占满了窗户上方的空间。
items.en: The mural fills the space above the window.
answers: The mural fills the space above the window.
items.notes: above 表示位置较高，不要求接触表面。

items.zh: 钥匙藏在门垫底下的一个信封里。
items.en: The key is in an envelope under the doormat.
answers: The key is in an envelope under the doormat.
items.notes: in 表容器内部，under 表位置关系；两层介词修饰。

items.zh: 第三条横杆靠在墙边，没有固定。
items.en: The third rail is leaning against the wall, unsecured.
answers: The third rail is leaning against the wall, unsecured.
items.notes: against 表示倚靠接触；unsecured：未固定的。

items.zh: 台阶旁边的扶手延伸到了入口处。
items.en: The handrail beside the steps extends to the entrance.
answers: The handrail beside the steps extends to the entrance.
items.notes: beside：旁边；to 标明延伸终点。

items.zh: 展品周围有一道低矮的围栏。
items.en: A low barrier surrounds the exhibit.
answers: A low barrier surrounds the exhibit.
items.notes: surround 是及物动词，此处不再加 around。

items.zh: 地下通道从广场下面穿过。
items.en: The passage runs underneath the square.
answers: The passage runs underneath the square.
items.notes: underneath 描述路径在另一物体下方。

items.zh: 小船穿过桥洞后向左转。
items.en: The boat turns left after passing through the arch.
answers: The boat turns left after passing through the arch.
items.notes: through 表穿过有边界的空间；after 后接动名词。

items.zh: 邮递员抄近路穿过了草坪。
items.en: The postman took a shortcut across the lawn.
answers: The postman took a shortcut across the lawn.
items.notes: across 表从平面的一侧到另一侧。

items.zh: 电线沿着墙脚一直通到厨房。
items.en: The cable runs along the base of the wall into the kitchen.
answers: The cable runs along the base of the wall into the kitchen.
items.notes: along 描述沿线方向；into 表进入房间。

items.zh: 我们绕开水坑走到了公交站。
items.en: We walked around the puddle to the bus stop.
answers: We walked around the puddle to the bus stop.
items.notes: around 表绕行；to 表目的地。

items.zh: 从隧道里出来后，你会看到码头。
items.en: You will see the pier when you come out of the tunnel.
answers: You will see the pier when you come out of the tunnel.
items.notes: out of 表从内部出来，不能只用 out 接名词。

items.zh: 孩子沿楼梯滑下了玩具车。
items.en: The child sent the toy car down the stairs.
answers: The child sent the toy car down the stairs.
items.notes: down 描述向下的运动路径。

items.zh: 把托盘从窄门里侧着搬过去。
items.en: Carry the tray sideways through the narrow doorway.
answers: Carry the tray sideways through the narrow doorway.
items.notes: through 用于门洞；sideways 是方式副词。

items.zh: 乌云从屋顶上空掠过。
items.en: Dark clouds swept over the rooftops.
answers: Dark clouds swept over the rooftops.
items.notes: over 表经过上方；sweep：掠过。

items.zh: 这条路在农舍前经过，但不进入院子。
items.en: The road goes past the farmhouse without entering the yard.
answers: The road goes past the farmhouse without entering the yard.
items.notes: past 表经过旁边；enter 为及物动词，不加 into。

items.zh: 那名跑步者正朝出口跑，但还没有到。
items.en: The runner is heading towards the exit but has not reached it.
answers: The runner is heading towards the exit but has not reached it.
The runner is heading towards the exit but hasn't reached it.
items.notes: towards 仅表方向，reach 直接接终点。

items.zh: 把椅子往后挪，离开暖气片。
items.en: Move the chair back, away from the radiator.
answers: Move the chair back, away from the radiator.
items.notes: away from 表远离；back 为方向副词。

items.zh: 硬币从我的口袋里掉进了排水沟。
items.en: A coin fell from my pocket into the drain.
answers: A coin fell from my pocket into the drain.
items.notes: from 标来源；into 标进入的终点。

items.zh: 镜头朝向观众，背对舞台。
items.en: The camera faces the audience, away from the stage.
answers: The camera faces the audience, away from the stage.
items.notes: face 直接接对象；away from 表背离方向。

items.zh: 从大门到温室有一条石子路。
items.en: A gravel path leads from the gate to the greenhouse.
answers: A gravel path leads from the gate to the greenhouse.
items.notes: from ... to ... 描述起终点。

items.zh: 最后几阶台阶通向一个小阁楼。
items.en: The last few steps lead up to a small attic.
answers: The last few steps lead up to a small attic.
items.notes: up 表向上；to 表终点，两者各有作用。

items.zh: 有些鸟顺着气流上升到山脊上方。
items.en: Some birds rise on air currents above the ridge.
answers: Some birds rise on air currents above the ridge.
items.notes: on air currents 表借助气流；above 表最终高度关系。

items.zh: 路标让车辆驶离主路，进入临时停车区。
items.en: The signs direct vehicles off the main road into temporary parking.
answers: The signs direct vehicles off the main road into temporary parking.
items.notes: off 表离开原路线；into 表进入新区域。

items.zh: 把绳子从箱子下面穿过去，再从另一侧拉出来。
items.en: Pass the rope under the crate and pull it out on the other side.
answers: Pass the rope under the crate and pull it out on the other side.
items.notes: under 表路径；on the other side 表拉出的所在侧。

items.zh: 球弹向篱笆，又反弹回我脚边。
items.en: The ball bounced towards the fence and back to my feet.
answers: The ball bounced towards the fence and back to my feet.
items.notes: towards 不保证到达；back to 表返回终点。

items.zh: 我们在日落时分收起了画架。
items.en: We packed away the easels at sunset.
answers: We packed away the easels at sunset.
items.notes: at 接具体时点，如 sunset，而非 on sunset。

items.zh: 检查安排在周五早晨。
items.en: The inspection is scheduled for Friday morning.
answers: The inspection is scheduled for Friday morning.
items.notes: schedule for 指安排的时间；有具体星期的早晨可用 on。

items.zh: 交谈中途，门铃响了。
items.en: The doorbell rang in the middle of our conversation.
answers: The doorbell rang in the middle of our conversation.
items.notes: in the middle of 表一段活动的中间。

items.zh: 这块地冬季不对外开放。
items.en: The grounds are closed to visitors in winter.
answers: The grounds are closed to visitors in winter.
items.notes: in 接季节；closed to 表不对某类人开放。

items.zh: 演出期间请不要使用闪光灯。
items.en: Please avoid flash photography during the performance.
answers: Please avoid flash photography during the performance.
items.notes: during 后接事件名词，说明事件期间。

items.zh: 两场演出之间有半小时休息。
items.en: There is a half-hour break between the performances.
answers: There is a half-hour break between the performances.
items.notes: between 用于两个事件之间的间隔。

items.zh: 我在午餐后不久接到了确认电话。
items.en: The confirmation call came shortly after lunch.
answers: The confirmation call came shortly after lunch.
items.notes: after 表晚于；shortly 修饰时间间隔。

items.zh: 这个街区一到夜里就很安静。
items.en: The neighbourhood is quiet at night.
answers: The neighbourhood is quiet at night.
items.notes: at night 是泛指夜间的惯用表达。

items.zh: 他们选在一个寒冷的早晨出发。
items.en: They set off on a cold morning.
answers: They set off on a cold morning.
items.notes: 具体描述的某个早晨用 on，而非泛指的 in the morning。

items.zh: 请在访问之前告知我们人数。
items.en: Please tell us the group size before your visit.
answers: Please tell us the group size before your visit.
items.notes: before 后接名词 visit，表示早于该事件。

items.zh: 借来的投影仪必须在中午之前送还。
items.en: The borrowed projector must be returned by noon.
answers: The borrowed projector must be returned by noon.
items.notes: by 表不晚于某时；与一直持续到某时的 until 区分。

items.zh: 你可以把画留在这里直到展览结束。
items.en: You may leave the painting here until the exhibition closes.
answers: You may leave the painting here until the exhibition closes.
items.notes: until 表持续终点，强调可留置的时段。

items.zh: 维修需要进行两天，这期间电梯无法使用。
items.en: The lift will be unavailable for two days during the repairs.
answers: The lift will be unavailable for two days during the repairs.
items.notes: for 接持续长度；during 接事件。

items.zh: 请在收到邀请后的三天内回复。
items.en: Please reply within three days of receiving the invitation.
answers: Please reply within three days of receiving the invitation.
items.notes: within 表不超过时间界限；of 标起算事件。

items.zh: 在开门前十分钟到达就足够了。
items.en: Arriving ten minutes before the doors open is sufficient.
answers: Arriving ten minutes before the doors open is sufficient.
items.notes: 时间量放 before 前，表示提前多少。

items.zh: 超时之后，每多停一小时都会收费。
items.en: Beyond the time limit, a charge applies for each additional hour.
answers: Beyond the time limit, a charge applies for each additional hour.
items.notes: beyond 表超过界限；for each 表按单位收费。

items.zh: 我会隔一天检查一次邮箱。
items.en: I will check the mailbox every other day.
answers: I will check the mailbox every other day.
items.notes: every other day 表每隔一天，前面不加 in 或 on。

items.zh: 报名可在三月一日至十五日期间办理。
items.en: Registration is open from 1 to 15 March.
answers: Registration is open from 1 to 15 March.
items.notes: from ... to ... 表范围；to 不等于截止含义的 by。

items.zh: 活动将在半小时后开始，所以现在还有准备时间。
items.en: The activity starts in half an hour, leaving time to prepare.
answers: The activity starts in half an hour, leaving time to prepare.
items.notes: in + 时长表示从现在起多久以后，而非持续多久。

items.zh: 整个假期里，花园一直有人照料。
items.en: The garden receives care throughout the holiday.
answers: The garden receives care throughout the holiday.
items.notes: throughout 强调覆盖整个期间。

items.zh: 这个地址在免费配送范围之外。
items.en: The address lies outside the free delivery zone.
answers: The address lies outside the free delivery zone.
items.notes: outside 表在界限外，不等于 away from 的距离远离。

items.zh: 两张床之间至少要留出一米。
items.en: Leave at least a metre between the beds.
answers: Leave at least a metre between the beds.
items.notes: between 指间隔位置；at least 表最低值。

items.zh: 信号在墙的另一侧明显变弱。
items.en: The signal becomes weaker on the other side of the wall.
answers: The signal becomes weaker on the other side of the wall.
items.notes: on the other side of：在另一侧，强调位置而非穿过动作。

items.zh: 我们在海平面以下十二米处看到了这个洞口。
items.en: We spotted the opening twelve metres below sea level.
answers: We spotted the opening twelve metres below sea level.
items.notes: 距离量 + below + 基准面，表示低于基准多少。

items.zh: 这些盒子按尺寸排列，从小到大。
items.en: The boxes are arranged by size, from smallest to largest.
answers: The boxes are arranged by size, from smallest to largest.
items.notes: by 表分类依据；from ... to ... 表排序两端。

items.zh: 小径距离悬崖边缘还有几米。
items.en: The path is several metres from the cliff edge.
answers: The path is several metres from the cliff edge.
items.notes: 距离量 + from 表与参照点的距离。

items.zh: 水位已经低于最低刻度。
items.en: The water is below the lowest mark.
answers: The water is below the lowest mark.
items.notes: below 表低于基准，不要求在正下方。

items.zh: 城市边界以内的车辆适用同一规定。
items.en: Vehicles within the city boundary are subject to the same rule.
answers: Vehicles within the city boundary are subject to the same rule.
items.notes: within 表范围内；subject to 为固定搭配。

items.zh: 这个洞约有拇指那么宽。
items.en: The opening is about the width of a thumb.
answers: The opening is about the width of a thumb.
items.notes: of 表尺寸所属；about 表近似。

items.zh: 绳索横跨沟渠，离地面很高。
items.en: The rope stretches across the ditch, high above the ground.
answers: The rope stretches across the ditch, high above the ground.
items.notes: across 表横跨；above 表离地高度关系。
